decisions.reason: Adjustable cardboard quarter pallet adds complexity but fits core paper operations; its differentiated feature may meet niche demand, so likely performs near aspiration.
Pegboard back display is a standard cardboard retail format with steady demand, likely exceeding aspirations.
Standard cardboard quarter-pallet display is a core product with broad retail use, strongly above aspiration.
Eighth-pallet display serves smaller retail spaces but has lower demand; slack allows continued evaluation.
Wooden display pallet is outside the firm's paper-based competence and likely underperforms, triggering search for alternative resource uses.
Media product display faces declining physical media sales and likely falls short of aspirations, making divestment likely.
